_comment: Weekly early warning signals dashboard. Check every Monday.

signals.name: Signup to Activation Rate
signals.description: % of signups who create a child profile and generate a first plan
signals.action_if_critical: Simplify onboarding further. Remove any optional steps. Add guided tour.

signals.name: Day 7 Retention
signals.description: % of users who return to the product 7 days after activation
signals.action_if_critical: Run exit survey. Test different first-week engagement flows. Consider email/SMS nudges.

signals.name: AI Cost Per User Per Week
signals.description: Total AI infrastructure cost divided by active users
signals.action_if_critical: Reduce per-user AI budget. Switch to cheaper model. Increase cache TTL. Disable non-critical AI features.

signals.name: Week 2 Net Promoter Score
signals.description: NPS survey sent after 14 days of usage
signals.action_if_critical: Schedule user interviews immediately. Identify top 3 complaints. Fix before next cohort.

signals.name: Time to First Value
signals.description: Minutes from signup to first completed activity check-off
signals.action_if_critical: Pre-populate first plan. Auto-check first activity after 60 seconds of browsing. Reduce friction.

signals.name: Customer Acquisition Cost
signals.description: Total marketing spend divided by new paying customers
signals.action_if_critical: Pause paid acquisition. Ramp organic channels (referral, teacher invite). Fix retention first.

signals.name: Support Tickets About Setup
signals.description: % of total support tickets related to onboarding/setup confusion
signals.action_if_critical: Rewrite onboarding flow. Add tooltips. Consider live chat during onboarding.

signals.name: Weekly Active Sessions Per User
signals.description: Number of sessions per user per week
signals.action_if_critical: Add push notifications. Send weekly digest email. Introduce streaks/gamification.

signals.name: Trial to Paid Conversion Rate
signals.description: % of users who start a trial and convert to paid subscription
signals.action_if_critical: Test pricing. Add discount for annual. Add exit survey for non-converters. Consider freemium tier.

signals.name: Mobile Usage Share
signals.description: % of all sessions that occur on mobile devices
signals.action_if_critical: Prioritize mobile PWA improvements. Test mobile-specific onboarding. Add mobile push notifications.

signals.name: Referral Rate
signals.description: Number of referral invites sent per active user per month
signals.action_if_critical: Improve referral incentive. Add shareable progress reports. Add teacher invite prompt.

signals.name: Avg Integrations Activated Per User
signals.description: Average number of external integrations (LMS, wearables, etc.) per user
signals.action_if_critical: This is a warning sign. If users are attempting integrations, onboarding is missing core value. Focus on zero-config experience.
